recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Do not revert the later CodeableConcept, mandatory clinicalStatus, unknown-code, or terminology-definition refinements while reconciling FHIR-7581 because they came from later final Jira decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-7581 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification Patient Care change request for DSTU1 Condition. It asked to split the old overloaded Condition.clinicalStatus/status concept into verificationStatus and clinicalStatus, with active/relapse/remission/resolved clinical status values, and to add a usage note that Condition.stage and clinical status may have interdependencies.
initial_application: The change was explicitly applied by git commit 0a6643ad139240e0f578cbe596e007d6c516df3e, titled "Split Condition.status {#7581} {#7617} {#7864}". That commit added Condition.verificationStatus, changed Condition examples to carry both clinical and verification status where needed, and introduced the clinical status value set.
additional_context: FHIR-7864 was resolved as per FHIR-7581 and is duplicate background. Later final Patient Care decisions intentionally refined the same area: FHIR-16193 changed clinicalStatus and verificationStatus from code to CodeableConcept, FHIR-26464 clarified clinical status code definitions, and FHIR-29409 made clinicalStatus mandatory and added unknown for derived point-in-time conditions. These later decisions explain why the current value lists and cardinalities differ from the 2015 resolution text.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Condition is active in source/fhir.ini, source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml contains separate Condition.clinicalStatus and Condition.verificationStatus elements with separate required bindings, and source/condition/condition-notes.xml already contains the requested stage/status interdependency note.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-7864 was resolved as per FHIR-7581 and implemented by the same historical Condition.status split commit.

Made Condition.clinicalStatus 1..1 and added unknown, explaining current cardinality and value-list differences.
